subject: Sunwing Logistics — Payee account transfer & PO routing delegation
messages:
From: Rachel Park <rachel.park@sunwinglogistics.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: ap@sunwinglogistics.com
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Update to Sunwing payee details (bank account change)

Hi Marissa —

We completed our bank change with treasury last week and need Redwood to update the payee on file so future POs and payments go to the new account. I’ve attached the signed W-9 and the bank change form that our bank provided.

Can you confirm what you need from procurement to process this? Also let me know if a new PO will be issued to the same remit address or if we need to update the ship-to/PO owner in your vendor portal.

Thanks —
Rachel Park
Vendor Ops & Finance Liaison
Sunwing Logistics

Attachments: sunwing_signed_w9.pdf, bank_change_form.xlsx

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: Rachel Park <rachel.park@sunwinglogistics.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Update to Sunwing payee details (bank account change)

Hi Rachel —

Thanks for the forms and heads-up. We can process a bank update but need two items before we finalize the vendor record: a) a bank letter (or bank template confirmation) authorizing the account transfer, and b) confirmation of the primary AP contact for future POs (is Miguel the correct PO recipient?).

Next steps I propose:
- You upload the bank letter to the Drive link I created (I’ll share after this thread).
- Confirm whether POs should continue to reference the existing ship-to address or if Sunwing wants a delegated PO owner to be set in our portal (if delegated, we’ll set Miguel as the PO owner so routing and approvals flow to him).

Karthik, looping you in to confirm whether we should treat this as a straight vendor bank update (no new contract) or if finance needs an extra signoff due to the account change amount.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai
Cc: Rachel Park <rachel.park@sunwinglogistics.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 14:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Update to Sunwing payee details (bank account change)

Marissa —

Finance flagged that when a vendor changes bank accounts we run a quick triage: confirm ACH vs wire preferences, validate ACH test (micro-deposit) where available, and confirm tax documentation is complete. From the docs Rachel sent, W-9 is OK but we still need the bank letter. If Sunwing prefers POs routed to Miguel, we can set him as PO owner in the vendor portal; that will change the routing for any new purchase orders immediately.

Dev — can you add a note to the vendor record to temporarily block automated pay runs until we verify micro-deposits? Also create a portal task to assign Miguel as PO owner pending their confirmation.

Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Strategic Procurement

From: Miguel Santos <miguel.s@sunwinglogistics.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: ap@sunwinglogistics.com, dev_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 16:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Update to Sunwing payee details (bank account change)

Hi Marissa / Karthik —

Thanks — confirming yes, Miguel is the correct PO recipient and we want POs routed to him going forward. I’ve uploaded the bank letter to the Drive link you shared and copied AP on this thread for final confirmation of the micro-deposit test timing. We prefer ACH for day-to-day payments.

AP — please confirm once you receive the micro-deposit and we’ll mark the vendor record as verified.

Cheers,
Miguel Santos
Head of Payments Operations
Sunwing Logistics

Forwarded attachments: bank_letter_sunwing.pdf
